title: ProductOverrides
description: Optional, human-authored corrections for one product. Lives at <input_dir>/product-overrides.json, next to manifest.json. Combined with product-analysis.json at generation-plan build time — never written into product-analysis.json itself, so the model's original analysis stays intact and auditable.

wordmark_exact_text.description: Exact text of any embossed/printed wordmark or logo text, confirmed by a human against the reference photos.

part_counts.description: Confirmed exact counts of small critical parts, e.g. {"paw_tab_toe_pads": 4}.

confirmed_colors.description: Confirmed exact color names/values for the targeted variant.

functional_constraints.description: Human-confirmed functional rules (e.g. correct contact surface, orientation).

human_corrections.description: Free-form corrections found by a human reviewing a rejected candidate — e.g. "wordmark misspelled 'Hoki Found' in v1, must read 'Moki Found'".
